name: MINIFS
description: MINIFS returns the minimum value in a range that meets one or more criteria across corresponding criteria ranges.
tldr: Finds the smallest value where multiple conditions are all true.

parameters.name: min_range
parameters.description: The range of cells from which the minimum is returned.

parameters.name: criteria_range1
parameters.description: The first range tested against criteria1; must be the same size as min_range.

parameters.name: criteria_range2, criteria2, ...
parameters.description: Optional additional range/criteria pairs; all must be met (AND logic).

basicExample.description: Smallest sale for a specific product
basicExample.explanation: Among rows where column A is Apple, the smallest value in column C (e.g. 500) is returned.

advancedExamples.title: Minimum with two criteria
advancedExamples.scenario: Lowest sale in a region meeting a threshold
advancedExamples.description: Both conditions must be satisfied (AND logic).
advancedExamples.explanation: Only rows where region is West AND column B is at least 100 are considered; the smallest such column C value is 120.

advancedExamples.title: Criterion with a cell reference
advancedExamples.description: Concatenate a comparison operator with a cell value.
advancedExamples.explanation: If E1 holds 50, this finds the smallest column C for Banana where column B exceeds 50, here 80.

howItWorks: MINIFS evaluates each criteria_range against its criteria, keeping only the rows where all conditions are true. It then returns the minimum value from min_range at those rows. All ranges must have the same dimensions. If no row satisfies every criterion, MINIFS returns 0. Criteria support operators (>, <, >=, <=, <>) and wildcards (*, ?) for text. It is the conditional counterpart of MIN, analogous to SUMIFS for SUM.

howToSteps.name: Select the result cell
howToSteps.text: Click where you want the minimum.

limitations: All ranges must be the same size; mismatched sizes cause #VALUE!.
Applies AND logic only; OR logic requires separate formulas combined with MIN.
Returns 0 when no row meets all criteria, which can be confused with a real zero.

commonErrors.cause: The criteria ranges and min_range have different sizes or shapes.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure every range covers the same rows and columns.

commonErrors.cause: Criteria text does not exactly match, including case differences or stray spaces.
commonErrors.fix: Use exact text, trim spaces, or use wildcards for partial matches.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: Google Sheets supports MINIFS with the same syntax, criteria rules, and AND logic as Excel 2019+.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Returns the smallest Apple value, identical to Excel.

faq.question: Can MINIFS use OR logic?
faq.answer: No, it only applies AND across criteria pairs. For OR, compute separate MINIFS and wrap them in MIN, or use MIN with FILTER.

faq.question: Why do I get 0?
faq.answer: No row satisfied all criteria, and MINIFS returns 0 in that case. Check your criteria and ranges.

faq.question: Which Excel versions have MINIFS?
faq.answer: MINIFS was introduced in Excel 2019 and is also in Microsoft 365; it is not available in Excel 2016 and earlier.
